lastCompletedStory.title: Collapse tmux layout to 2 panes (orchestrator + dashboard) and widen the dashboard clamp

nextStoryContext: US-002 collapsed the session from 3 panes to 2 panes (orchestrator + dashboard). CreatedPaneIds.menuPaneId is gone. isSessionStale now checks commands.length !== 2. clampDashboardWidth uses 26% proportion with bounds 34-80; at 188 cols yields 49 cols (fits tokens row). The hook shell formula is (w*26+50)/100 with t<34?34:t>80?80:t. run.ts setupPanes no longer respawns or labels the menu pane. All 781 tests pass.
